parameters.description: Where the requests came from: anywhere, search engines, other websites, or a project such as en.wikipedia. Defaults to anywhere.
parameters.name: referer

parameters.description: Only count this kind of file. Defaults to all media.
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.description: The day to list (or any day in the month, for a whole month). Leave empty for yesterday.
parameters.name: day

parameters.description: That day alone, or the whole month it falls in.
parameters.name: period

parameters.description: How many to list, from the top, 1 to 1,000. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD), or the month (YYYY-MM) for a whole month.

rank.description: Its place in the list, 1 being the highest.

requests.description: Times it was downloaded in that period.

media_type.description: all-media-types, image, video, audio, document or other.

period.description: 'day' for one day's figures, 'month' for a whole month's.

referer.description: Where the requests came from: all-referers, internal, external, search-engine, unknown, none, or a project such as en.wikipedia.

list_most_viewed_pages.description: List a project's most-viewed pages on a day or over a whole month, with their views, up to 1,000 of them. A day's figures are ready the next day.
list_most_viewed_pages.name: list_most_viewed_pages

parameters.description: The wiki, such as en.wikipedia (English Wikipedia), de.wiktionary or commons.wikimedia. Pick one, or type its address.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: The day to list (or any day in the month, for a whole month). Leave empty for yesterday.
parameters.name: day

parameters.description: That day alone, or the whole month it falls in.
parameters.name: period

parameters.description: Count views on the desktop site, the mobile site, the apps, or all.
parameters.name: access

parameters.description: How many to list, from the top, 1 to 1,000. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD), or the month (YYYY-MM) for a whole month.

rank.description: Its place in the list, 1 being the highest.

title.description: The page's title, with spaces, e.g. 'Albert Einstein'.

period.description: 'day' for one day's figures, 'month' for a whole month's.

project.description: The project, as the API names it: en.wikipedia, commons.wikimedia, or all-projects for every project together.

list_most_viewed_pages_by_country.description: List the pages people in one country read most on a day, across every Wikimedia project, with their views rounded up for privacy. Bots are left out.
list_most_viewed_pages_by_country.display_name: List most-viewed pages in a country
list_most_viewed_pages_by_country.name: list_most_viewed_pages_by_country

parameters.description: The country, or its two-letter code such as FR.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: The day to list. Leave empty for yesterday.
parameters.name: day

parameters.description: Count views on the desktop site, the mobile site, the apps, or all.
parameters.name: access

parameters.description: How many to list, from the top, 1 to 1,000. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

country_name.description: The country's name in English, e.g. 'France'.

project.description: The project the page is on, e.g. fr.wikipedia.

rank.description: Its place in the list, 1 being the highest.

title.description: The page's title, with spaces, e.g. 'Albert Einstein'.

views.description: Views from that country, rounded up to protect readers' privacy.

description: Statistics for Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia projects: page views of a page or a whole project, the most-viewed pages by project or country, unique devices, edits, editors, new users and pages, bytes changed, and downloads of media files. No account or API key required.
